text:
lina_finance: Heads up team — spotted a charge anomaly on MediCore's private deployment renewal (invoice MC-2024-215). Looks like a legacy vendor add-on code `VND-XL` got applied which bumped platform fee and support.
paul_am: Yikes. How much are we talking?
lina_finance: Preliminary numbers: invoice billed $238,750 total. Expected per SOW: $196,000. Delta = $42,750 before tax. Breakdown: platform fee applied at 14% vs contracted 8%; support upgraded to Premium Managed ($34k) vs Contracted Pro Support ($18k).
paul_am: Did customer sign an amendment? Any email thread?
rahul_ops: I pulled renewal notes — AM didn't request any upgrade. Ops tickets show no feature flags turned on for Premium Managed. Looks like a mapping between SOW line-item codes and our billing SKU table that maps `VND-XL` to Premium. We deprecated that code but a backfill job reintroduced it during a staging migration. Ticket OPS-1189.
lina_finance: Copying the invoice lines for record:

```
Billed:
1) OnPrem License - Enterprise - $160,000
2) Platform Fee (14%) - $22,400
3) Support (Premium Managed) - $56,350

Contract SOW expected:
2) Platform Fee (8%) - $12,800
3) Support (Pro Support) - $18,400
```

lina_finance: Platform diff = $9,600; Support diff = $37,950. Total = $47,550? Wait that's off vs earlier calc. Let me re-run ledger export.
billing_bot: LEDGER QUERY COMPLETE: Account MEDICORE (acct_009877). Confirmed billed support line = $56,350, contracted support line = $18,400. Support delta = $37,950. Platform delta = $9,600. Total delta = $47,550. Previously flagged numbers were pre-discount.
lina_finance: Thanks billing_bot. So correct delta = $47,550 pre-tax. That crosses VP Finance approval threshold.
paul_am: We need to propose remediation: full credit for the mis-applied delta + optional goodwill: one quarter of Pro Support free or 2 months free platform. Thoughts?
rahul_ops: Ops: we should also block the backfill job and run a full audit on billing SKU mappings for last 18 months. OPS-1189 will include an export of all runs. ETA 3 days.
legal_bot: Note: If we issue a credit > $25k, legal requests customer acknowledgement to prevent chargeback claims. Recommend getting written acceptance of credit as resolution.
lina_finance: Agreed. @paul_am please confirm customer prefers credit to next invoice or refund to ACH. We also need their sign-off on settlement doc.
paul_am: Reached out to customer — they prefer a credit applied to account + signed settlement note. I'll get the OK.
paul_am: MediCore reply: "We did not authorize any upgrades. Credit to account is fine, please send settlement doc."
lina_finance: Routing for approval: request VP Finance approval to issue credit memo $47,550, apply to next invoice, issue goodwill 2 months of platform for free, and require customer settlement acknowledgement. VP Finance approval required for > $25k.
vp_finance: Reviewing. Please include an internal remediation plan and timeline before approve. Also confirm how this impacts revenue recognition (will we reverse recognized revenue?).
lina_finance: Revenue ops: we will reverse the recognized portion tied to the mis-billed lines. I'll coordinate with RevRec and post an adjusting journal entry. Remediation plan: 1) Block backfill job (done) 2) Audit last 18 months SKU mappings (OPS-1189) 3) Add unit test to migration pipeline to prevent deprecated codes (OPS-1190) 4) Issue credit + settlement doc. ETA 7 business days to complete the audit.
vp_finance: Approved pending RevRec note and copy of settlement doc. Approve credit memo $47,550 applied to next invoice. Capture approval: "VP Finance 1766667777 approved credit for MediCore due to legacy SKU mapping; require settlement doc signed."
lina_finance: Approved. Creating credit memo CM-2024-221 and applying to account. Draft settlement note attached to this thread (email will follow).
billing_bot: CREDIT MEMO CREATED -> CM-2024-221 | Amount: $47,550 | Apply: next invoice | Status: pending customer settlement ack.
paul_am: Sent settlement doc, customer signed within 24 hours. Reply: "Settlement accepted and credit applied. Thank you."
rahul_ops: OPS-1189 started. Found 2 other accounts with `VND-XL` used during the same migration window. Opening follow-ups.
lina_finance: Noted — will create file for potential additional credits after audit completes. For MediCore this thread closed after credit application.
paul_am: Customer confirmed credit applied and balance showed -$47,550 credit on portal.
lina_finance: Posting final audit note to invoice MC-2024-215 and closing thread.
